verses.text: A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.
lines: A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh,
but accurate weights are his delight.

verses.text: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.
lines: When pride comes, then comes shame,
but with humility comes wisdom.

verses.text: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.
lines: The integrity of the upright shall guide them,
but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.

verses.text: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
lines: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath,
but righteousness delivers from death.

verses.text: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
lines: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way,
but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

verses.text: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.
lines: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them,
but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.

verses.text: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.
lines: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes,
and expectation of power comes to nothing.

verses.text: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.
lines: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble,
and the wicked takes his place.

verses.text: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.
lines: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor,
but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.

verses.text: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.
lines: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices.
When the wicked perish, there is shouting.

verses.text: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
lines: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted,
but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

verses.text: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.
lines: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom,
but a man of understanding holds his peace.

verses.text: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.
lines: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence,
but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.

verses.text: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.
lines: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls,
but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.

verses.text: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.
lines: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it,
but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.

verses.text: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.
lines: A gracious woman obtains honor,
but violent men obtain riches.

verses.text: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.
lines: The merciful man does good to his own soul,
but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.

verses.text: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
lines: Wicked people earn deceitful wages,
but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.

verses.text: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.
lines: He who is truly righteous gets life.
He who pursues evil gets death.

verses.text: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to Yahweh, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.
lines: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to Yahweh,
but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.

verses.text: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.
lines: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished,
but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.

verses.text: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.
lines: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout,
is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.

verses.text: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.
lines: The desire of the righteous is only good.
The expectation of the wicked is wrath.

verses.text: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.
lines: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more.
There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.

verses.text: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.
lines: The liberal soul shall be made fat.
He who waters shall be watered also himself.

verses.text: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.
lines: People curse someone who withholds grain,
but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.

verses.text: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.
lines: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor,
but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.

verses.text: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.
lines: He who trusts in his riches will fall,
but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.

verses.text: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.
lines: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind.
The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.

verses.text: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.
lines: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life.
He who is wise wins souls.

verses.text: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid in the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!
lines: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid in the earth,
how much more the wicked and the sinner!
